summary: PgWorkStore: the forge-postgres adapter struct implementing forge-work's three driven ports. Holds the session factory, the owner scope, the allowed projects, the pending cap, and the review policy; the port impls live in the work_read / work_admission / work_decision modules and their delegation targets.
responsibilities: ReviewPolicy mirrors Python's DEFAULT_REPAIR_POLICY; agent_defaults() returns version forge-repair-v1, max_rounds 20, max_stagnant_rounds 20, max_infrastructure_retries 20, required_hosted_checks [check, pr-fast-gate, real-browser] (AGENT_RETRY_LIMIT = 20).

session() creates a fresh PgSession through the factory's Factory::create (a transient session per operation, the pattern the worker/reconciler surfaces use) and maps AdapterError via work_common::work_err.
The struct itself implements no port; it is the shared state the three port impls and their delegation targets use.
invariants: No SQL in this file. No port logic in this file.
idioms: // forge_core::provider::Factory (exact): fn create(&self) -> Result<PgSession, AdapterError> for PgSessionFactory.
